slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy. Accepted iff FUN_0801262c sum+complement verification over [0x00,0x88) passes and FUN_080172e8 16-byte header template comparison passes; otherwise the RAM struct is rewritten via FUN_080125b4. No backup, mirror, or generation counter exists; bytes 0x90-0x1FF are 0xFF fill.

checksums.name: payload_sum32_and_complement
checksums.formula_detail: sum = sum of unsigned bytes over [0x00,0x88) (136 bytes, header included) in a 32-bit accumulator; complement = ~sum (32-bit). Code stores sum as LE u32 at RAM offset 0x88 and ~sum as LE u32 at RAM offset 0x8C (FUN_080125b4 writes, FUN_0801262c compares, return 0 iff both match else -1). In the raw .sav the 8-byte block at 0x88 is byte-reversed: 0x88 holds ~sum as BE u32, 0x8C holds sum as BE u32, i.e. sav[0x88:0x90] == reverse(pack('<I',sum)+pack('<I',~sum)). Delta between samples (+298) exactly equals the byte-sum of the inserted 'PMID' word.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 raw transfer helper: programs SAD/DAD/CNT (CNT = len|0x80000000), spins on CNT bit15, restores IRQ mask. Used for every EEPROM bitstream transfer to/from 0x0D000000.

EEPROM read one 8-byte block: MSB-first address bitstream DMA-written to 0x0D000000 (addr_bits+3 halfwords), then 0x44 halfwords DMA-read back and reassembled MSB-first into 4 u16 stored in reverse word order. Device block-count guard at type_ptr+4.

EEPROM write one 8-byte block: 64 data bits + address bits DMA-written to 0x0D000000 (addr_bits+0x43 halfwords), completion via FUN_08369efc, polls uRam0d000000 bit0, teardown FUN_08369f84. No recovered direct caller; reached via inferred thunk 0x0836a3a0.
EEPROM read-and-compare one block via FUN_0836a048; returns 0 on match, 0x8000 on mismatch. Possibly the body behind thunk 0x0836a3ac or a verify-after-write step.
Unrecovered jump-table thunk; inferred EEPROM write-block (block_index, ptr). Called 18 times by the serializer (17 payload blocks + checksum block), ptr stepping 8 bytes.
Unrecovered jump-table thunk; inferred EEPROM read-block (block_index, ptr). Called 18 times by the verifier, ptr stepping 8 bytes.
Serializer + checksum writer: writes payload blocks 0..16 via 0x0836a3a0, computes byte sum over [0x00,0x88), stores sum at +0x88 and ~sum at +0x8C, writes block 17.
Loader + verifier: reads blocks 0..17 via 0x0836a3ac, recomputes sum over [0x00,0x88), returns 0 iff stored sum and complement both match, else -1.

Validate-or-rewrite: mode 0 loads+verifies via FUN_0801262c, compares 16-byte header against ROM template 0x08017378 (4 u32 words); on failure sets status and rewrites via FUN_080008b0 DMA + FUN_080125b4. Also reached from untraced jump-table callers.

Sanitizer: copies source struct, clamps 3x8B records at +0x10, 11 u16 at +0x48 to <=9, counter at +0x70, mode bytes at +0x78/0x79 to 0..2, byte at +0x80 to <=4. Base pointer is a different literal slot than the serializer base; sav-offset mapping is hypothesized.
Generic DMA3 copy helper (CNT_H 0x8400), not EEPROM-specific; used by the validate-or-rewrite path for a RAM transfer before rewriting.

fields.name: header_magic_prefix
fields.update_mechanism: Part of 16-byte header compared word-wise against ROM template 0x08017378 by FUN_080172e8 after load; included in checksum. Written only as part of whole-image serialization.
fields.evidence: Identical in both valid .sav files; FUN_080172e8 4xu32 compare loop over struct base; checksum covers offset 0 and verifies.

fields.name: header_variable_word
fields.update_mechanism: Proven mutation site between the two retained snapshots (+298 sum delta exactly equals 'PMID' byte sum); covered by checksum bytes 0x8A-0x8B/0x8E-0x8F. Semantic trigger unknown. PACKET.md probe mutated offset 0x4 and triggered rewrite, proving integrity protection, not semantics.
fields.evidence: Only differing payload word between samples (hexdump_and_diffs.txt offsets 0x04-0x07); cannot be fixed magic because both saves were retained/loaded; code role beyond template comparison unknown.

fields.name: header_magic_suffix
fields.update_mechanism: Words 2-3 of the FUN_080172e8 ROM-template comparison; included in checksum; written only via whole-image serialization.
fields.evidence: Identical in both valid .sav files and inside the compared 16-byte range; interpreted as constant data/framework identifier, not gameplay state.

fields.name: records_x3
fields.update_mechanism: Hypothesized three 8-byte records (stride 8 from +0x10, count 3) clamped by FUN_0801744c and bubble-sorted by FUN_0801760c on the +6 u16 key before FUN_080125b4 flushes. Contains 3-char ASCII fragments at record bytes +3..+5 (NEK/OYR/EEL) and u16-LE-like values at +1 (0x00F4/0x0090/0x002C). Sanitizer byte+1 clamp conflicts with observed 0xF4, so mapping may describe a working copy, not the flushed struct.
fields.evidence: Record stride/count and sort key from FUN_0801744c/FUN_0801760c bodies (static, different literal base); byte layout and ASCII fragments observed identically in both .sav files; no sample variation to verify semantics.

fields.name: zero_region_a
fields.update_mechanism: No traced writer other than whole-image serialization. FUN_0801744c hypothesized u16 clamp range +0x48..+0x5D (<=9) lies inside this region and is consistent with zeros. FUN_08016dbc copies source +0x68 onward, just above this field.
fields.evidence: All zero in both samples; only static sanitizer overlap (hypothesized base) suggests reserved counters/flags. Distinguished from 0xFF fill: these zeros are inside the checksummed, written payload (EEPROM-written zeros, not erased state).

fields.name: tail_fields_and_settings_hypothesis
fields.update_mechanism: Hypothesized: clamped counter at +0x70, mode bytes at +0x78/0x79 (range 0..2) per FUN_0801744c; FUN_08016dbc copies +0x68/0x6A/0x6C/0x78/0x79 into live state after load. Observed 0x7E/0x7F=01 01 have no traced writer.
fields.evidence: Offsets from FUN_0801744c/FUN_08016dbc bodies (static, unrecovered literal bases); values in both .sav files are in-range zeros except 0x7E/0x7F. No variation between samples.

fields.name: zero_region_b
fields.update_mechanism: Last payload bytes before the integrity block. Hypothesized byte at +0x80 clamped to <=4 by FUN_0801744c; observed 0x00 satisfies the clamp. Otherwise reserved/zero.
fields.evidence: Inside checksummed payload and written by FUN_080125b4; all zero in both samples; only static clamp hypothesis touches +0x80.

fields.name: checksum_complement_be
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_080125b4 stores ~sum as LE u32 at RAM +0x8C after storing sum at +0x88; serial EEPROM transfer byte-reverses the block, so the raw .sav holds ~sum big-endian at 0x88. FUN_0801262c requires ~computed == stored word (RAM comparison). Never edit without recomputing both words.
fields.evidence: Python recomputation matches stored BE value on both files; sav[0x88:0x90] == reverse(pack('<I',sum)+pack('<I',~sum)) verified true on both.

fields.name: checksum_sum_be
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_080125b4 stores sum of bytes [0x00,0x88) as LE u32 at RAM +0x88; byte-reversed into BE at .sav 0x8C by the EEPROM transfer. FUN_0801262c requires computed == stored word (RAM comparison). Repair rule: recompute sum, write BE sum here and BE complement at 0x88.
fields.evidence: Python: computed 0x00000741/0x0000086b equals stored BE on both files; inter-sample delta +298 equals 'PMID' insertion byte sum.

fields.name: unused_eeprom_fill
fields.update_mechanism: Never read or written by any traced function (serializer/verifier stop at block 17). Erased EEPROM state retained by the emulator dump.
fields.evidence: Byte scan: zero non-0xFF bytes at >=0x90 in both files; no call site references block indices >=18.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Replace 00 00 00 00 with PMID (cap-00 -> cap-01 direction) and vice versa; repair checksums per rule
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: With repair: save retained (proven by sample pair); observe what gameplay/UI state, if any, tracks this word to identify the field. Without repair: rewrite/blank behavior per probe.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Flip one byte (e.g. 0x00 -> 0x01) with no checksum repair
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: FUN_0801262c returns -1; FUN_080172e8 rewrites via FUN_080125b4; emulated save reverts toward blank/default and visual state changes. Control proving the integrity gate (mirrors PACKET.md probe at 0x4).

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Corrupt header prefix byte 0x50 -> 0x51, with checksum repair
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Checksum passes but FUN_080172e8 16-byte ROM-template comparison fails; save rejected/rewritten despite valid sum. Isolates the header gate from the checksum gate.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Corrupt complement word only (sav 0x88 BE ~sum), leave sum word intact
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: FUN_0801262c second comparison (~computed == stored) fails; load rejected/rewritten. Proves the complement is independently checked, not decorative.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Change record byte 0x11 (0xF4 -> 0x05, inside hypothesized records_x3), with checksum repair
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If FUN_0801744c sanitizes the flushed struct, the value is forced to 0 or clamped on next save (re-flushed .sav shows the rewrite); if it persists, the sanitizer acts on a different working copy. Directly resolves the Section 5 static-mapping conflict.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set 0x7E/0x7F from 01 01 to 00 00, 02 02, and FF FF in separate trials, with checksum repair
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Observe settings-like behavior (language/sound/difficulty) or clamping on re-save; identifies the only non-zero tail bytes. FF FF tests whether any clamp (hypothesized 0..2 at +0x78/0x79, offset by two) touches these offsets.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Write non-FF pattern at 0x90-0x9F, no checksum change
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: No observable effect and bytes never read back into RAM; confirms the unused-fill boundary at 0x90 and that no hidden second slot exists.

open_questions: RAM mirror address of the save struct: literal-pool pointer values at ROM slots 0x08012628/0x080126a4/0x08017330/0x080175f4/0x080175f8 were not recovered in the workspace decompilation, so all ram_addr entries are null.

ROM template bytes at 0x08017378 compared by FUN_080172e8 (especially word 1): the ROM is not in the workspace, so whether the template tolerates the 00 00 00 00 vs PMID variation or one sample was rewritten post-capture cannot be decided.

Bodies of jump-table thunks 0x0836a3a0/0x0836a3ac/0x0836a388/0x0836a394 and siblings at 0x0836a340-0x0836a3d0: write/read-block roles are inferred from call sites; exact wrappers and the FUN_08012594 EEPROM detect/configure argument semantics remain static hypotheses.

Whether FUN_0801744c/FUN_0801760c sanitize/sort the flushed save struct or a distinct working copy: their literal base differs from the serializer base and the byte+1 clamp conflicts with observed 0xF4 at offset 0x11.

Semantics of payload fields: records at 0x10-0x27 (score/name-like layout unproven), field at 0x04-0x07 (only proven mutation), tail bytes 0x7E/0x7F, and the zero regions 0x28-0x87, which barely vary across the two snapshots.
